### Observed differences

- The five activities A35, A36, A41, A42 and A43 exchanged their order with A27 and A26. In the earlier window, A26 preceded each of the five in about 98 in 100 traces and A27 preceded them in about 99–100 in 100; in the later window, each of the five precedes A26 in about 98–99 in 100 traces and precedes A27 in about 98–99 in 100. All these pairs still co-occur in 100 in 100 traces in both windows. [REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021]
- The old close succession disappeared. Earlier, A26 was followed by each of the five within five steps in about 195–200 of 200 traces, and each of the five was followed by A30 within five steps in about 195–200 of 200 traces; in the later window, each of these ordered pairs appears in only 1–2 of 200 traces. [LAG011, LAG012, LAG013, LAG014, LAG015, LAG016, LAG017, LAG018, LAG019]
- Successors were rewired. A26's outgoing edges, earlier spread over the five activities (about 15–23 in 100 each), now go about 98 in 100 to A30. Each of the five earlier sent about 18–25 in 100 of its outgoing edges to A30 and now almost none, while about 17–22 in 100 now go to A27. A25, which earlier sent about 99 in 100 outgoing edges to A27, now sends about 96 in 100 to the five activities combined. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008]
- Event positions (not clock time) shifted consistently: the five activities' mean relative position fell from about 0.60 to about 0.45, A27's rose from about 0.39 to 0.53, and A26's rose from about 0.52 to 0.66; each of these activities occurs in every trace in both windows. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008]
- A02 became much more frequent and earlier: it appears in about 14 in 100 traces in the earlier window versus about 41 in 100 in the later one (mean occurrences per trace 0.16 vs 0.45), and its mean relative position fell from about 0.60 to 0.32. Its outgoing edges, earlier scattered over many successors (largest share about 27 in 100 to A50), now concentrate on A19 (about 50 in 100) and A20 (about 32 in 100). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- A02's relations shifted accordingly: earlier it co-occurred with A25, A26, A27, A30 and each of the five in about 14 in 100 traces with no consistent order; in the later window co-occurrence is about 41 in 100 and A02 comes first in about 36–37 in 100, with the reverse order nearly gone. A46 now typically precedes A02 (distance 1 in about 97 in 100 of 75 after-pairs; A46's outgoing share to A02 rose from about 2 to 36 in 100), and A19 now precedes A35, A36, A41 and A43 within two to five steps in about 84–92 of 200 traces, against 1 trace earlier. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG020, DIR009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the segment formed by A35, A36, A41, A42 and A43 was repositioned: in the later window these five activities run before A27 and A26, with A25 now flowing into them, whereas in the earlier window they ran after A26 and before A30, and A26 now leads almost directly to A30. [REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021]

The support is direct and consistent: on pairs that co-occur in every trace in both windows, an equally fixed order flipped to the fixed reverse order; the old adjacencies (A26 into the block, the block into A30) fell from about 195–200 to 1–2 of 200 traces; successor profiles and event positions moved in the same direction. With 64 qualifying items against roughly 1 expected for an unchanged process, the ensemble is not what random re-splits typically produce. Limitations: the ten order reversals and nine adjacency losses describe one underlying move rather than independent confirmations, and the evidence cannot rule out that the two windows capture different mixes of process variants rather than a single flow whose ordering changed. [LAG011, LAG012, LAG013, LAG014, LAG015, LAG016, LAG017, LAG018, LAG019, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008]

Other differences: A02, together with A46 and A19, shows a separate participation and placement change not covered by the main hypothesis: A02 roughly tripled its presence (about 14 to 41 in 100 traces), moved to the early part of the trace, now typically follows A46 and precedes A19 and A20, and now precedes the main-line activities (A25, A26, A27, A30 and the five) in about 37 in 100 of their co-occurrences; A19 in turn now runs shortly before A35, A36, A41 and A43. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG020, DIR009]

Let me work through this evidence carefully.

We have 200 traces before, 200 after. Screening: 195 units tested, 64 items qualified, 0.97 expected without change. That's a count many times larger than the expectation (64 vs ~1), so the evidence as a whole cannot be explained by chance. So we're not in "insufficient evidence" territory by the screening comparison. All items are control-flow family (OCC, DIR, POS, REL, LAG).

Now let me understand the behavioural story.

Key items:

OCC001: A02 occurrences increased: mean per trace 0.155 → 0.445; participation 13.5% → 41%; recurrence support small. Support 27 → 82 traces. So A02 appears in about 14 in 100 traces before, about 41 in 100 after.

POS001: A02 position moved earlier: mean position 0.60 → 0.32 of trace length; median 0.65 → 0.31. Support 27 → 82.

DIR001: outgoing transitions of A02 redistributed: before, A02's outgoing edges spread across many successors (A50 0.27, A52 0.13, A43 0.10, ...); after, concentrated on A19 (0.50) and A20 (0.32). Support 30 → 88.

DIR002: A25's outgoing: before almost entirely A27 (0.99); after redistributed across A43 (0.22), A42 (0.20), A41 (0.19), A36 (0.19), A35 (0.15), A27 nearly gone (0.005). Support 200/201.

DIR003: A26's outgoing: before spread across A41 (0.23), A42 (0.21), A35 (0.21), A36 (0.19), A43 (0.15); after almost entirely A30 (0.98). Support 203/200.

DIR004: A35's outgoing: before included A30 (0.18); after A30 gone, A27 appears (0.21). Change 0.215.

DIR005: A36's outgoing: A30 (0.21) before → gone after; A27 (0.175) appears after.

DIR006: A41's outgoing: A30 (0.18) before → gone; A27 (0.20) after.

DIR007: A42's outgoing: A30 (0.18) before → gone; A27 (0.215) after.

DIR008: A43's outgoing: A30 (0.25) before → nearly gone (0.005); A27 (0.17) after.

So a consistent pattern: before, A35, A36, A41, A42, A43 (a block of activities) each had an edge to A30; after, that edge is gone and instead they connect to A27. Also A26 before distributed to A35/A36/A41/A42/A43; after A26 goes almost exclusively to A30.

POS items: A26 position moved later (0.52 → 0.66); A27 moved later (0.39 → 0.53); A35, A36, A41, A42, A43 all moved earlier (0.60 → 0.45).

REL items:

REL001 (A02, A19): co-occurrence 0.085 → 0.25; A_before_B 0.015 → 0.215; B_before_A 0.06 → 0.01. So A02 now usually precedes A19.

REL002–REL010 (A02 with A25, A26, A27, A30, A35, A36, A41, A42, A43): before, A02 co-occurred with these in 13.5% of traces and B_only 86.5%; after co-occurrence 41%, A_before_B rose from ~0.05 to ~0.37, B_before_A dropped to ~0. So A02 now typically runs before these activities.

REL011 (A02, A46): B_before_A rose 0.1 → 0.345; co-occurrence 0.135 → 0.41. So A46 now typically precedes A02.

REL012–REL016 (A26 with A35, A36, A41, A42, A43): before, A26 before B in ~98% of traces; after, B before A26 in ~98–99.5%. Complete order reversal. Co-occurrence stays 1.0 (both always in same trace).

REL017–REL021 (A27 with A35, A36, A41, A42, A43): before, A27 before B in ~99–100%; after, B before A27 in ~98–99%. Complete order reversal.

LAG items:

LAG011–LAG019: pairs (A26,A36), (A26,A41), (A26,A42), (A26,A43), (A35,A30), (A36,A30), (A41,A30), (A42,A30), (A43,A30): before support ~195–200, after support 1–2. These pairs were adjacent (within 5 steps) in nearly every trace before, and almost never after. Wait — LAG is ordered pair within five steps. The analysis unit values are e.g. ["A26","A36"] — presumably ordered pair A26 then A36. Before, A26→A36 within 5 steps in ~197 traces; after, in 1 trace. And LAG012 (A26,A41): after, lag 1 in 1 trace. Hmm, support after = 1.

Actually wait, let me reconsider. LAG011: before support 197, after support 1. The pair (A26, A36) within five steps: before, distances spread 1–5 roughly uniformly; after, only 1 occurrence with distance 3. So the ordered pair A26 followed by A36 within 5 steps essentially disappeared.

LAG013 (A26, A42): before 198; after 1 with distance 4.

LAG014 (A26, A43): before 195; after 1 with distance 5.

LAG015 (A35, A30): before 198; after 1 with distance 4.

LAG017 (A41, A30): before 196; after 1 with distance 5.
